label: mid-input positions (t=3-6) of sequences starting with k
explanation: Fires almost only during the original-input phase at positions 3-6 (peak at t=4-5, which hold about 87% of the mass), and about 90% of activation mass comes from sequences whose first token is k (25x lift). Never fires at t<=2 or t>=8, and never in the copy phase; there is a small amount at the delimiter step when the output is k. Magnitude is highest when the previous input is r (8.9x lift) and the current input is e, as in k u h r [e]. It is sparse within k-initial sequences, though: only about 16% of the predicted steps are active, and no simple condition on prefix tokens fixes this. The predicate captures most of the mass but has low precision.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=k (+9.96), prev_tok=r (+5.82), orig0=w (+4.23), orig0=2 (+3.75), orig2=u (+3.47), orig1=u (+3.41). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-6.00), phase=2 (-4.59), t=8 (-3.80), prev_tok=q (-3.64).
